Owner is the recorded fulfiller at 3 h per valuation: two per week = 6 h/week, exactly the ceiling, 18 h total of the 24 allowed. Direct cost and exposure $0. Deliveries on days 3/10/17 with settlement on days 13/20/27, all inside 28 days (the author waits 10 days from delivery where the card says 7, so the ledger is cautious). findings: No hours slack: each week uses the full 6 h, so if a signed school does not pay, the two spare acceptances can only be delivered by going over 6 h in a week or in week 4, which settles on day 28 or later. This is a risk to note, not a defect in the plan.
Brain cannot yet send messages or issue invoices (SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED). These have to be connected before s1/c1 can run.
